sources_considered.why: Primary benchmark evaluation explicitly distinguishes major progress from establishing AGI.
Independent assessment examines recent AGI declarations and explains unresolved evaluation criteria.
The evaluator's dated analysis provides more relevant interpretation of the benchmark results.
A categorical tracker answer supplies less useful evidence than the primary evaluation.

evidence_items.explanation: The benchmark evaluator reports substantial progress but explicitly declines to treat it as an AGI achievement. This leaves the antecedent unestablished; it does not prove that AGI has not been built elsewhere.

receipt.public_excerpt: There is no generally accepted empirical test for AGI.

evidence_items.explanation: This assessment considers public declarations that AGI has arrived but concludes that the published evidence does not establish the achievement. September 14 is the disclosed update date of the version read; the assessment does not establish Marcus's proposed necessary development method.

unresolved_gaps: The reviewed record does not establish an AGI achievement under the stated reading.
No qualifying system has a sufficiently documented development history here to test the proposed necessity.
Even an AGI system using human-inspired ideas would not alone establish that those ideas were required.
